name: How long does a typical pool renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical pool renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pool renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope. A minor cosmetic update, like replastering or tile replacement, might take 2-4 weeks. More extensive renovations involving structural changes, new decking, or adding features such as spas or water elements can extend to 6-12 weeks or even longer. Factors like material availability, weather conditions, inspection schedules, and the complexity of custom designs all influence the overall timeline. Your contractor should provide a detailed project schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; minor updates take 2-4 weeks, while extensive renovations can last 6-12 weeks or more.
